highlights.headline: Commission proposes €1.1 million from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund to support dismissed paper industry workers in Finland

items.title: Public asked to have their say on proposed new renewable energy company
items.description: The proposed plans aim to reduce the cost of energy in the long-term, but won't be able to set bills.

items.title: German police arrest suspect in power grid sabotage case
items.description: Investigators say the suspect used homemade rockets and conductive wire to target high-voltage lines in three German states, apparently as part of a campaign against fossil fuels.

items.title: Germany news: Gas reserves historically low ahead of winter
items.description: Gas storage operator association INES has warned that Germany's gas reserves could run out in the event of a cold winter. Meanwhile, fallout from the AfD's state election victory continues. Follow DW for the latest.
